question: In a village, at least 50% of the people read a newspaper. Among those who read a newspaper at the most 25% read more than one paper. Only one of the following statements follows from the statements we have given. Which one is it?

options.A: At the most 25% read exactly one newspaper.
options.B: At least 25% read all the newspapers.
options.C: At the most $37\frac12\%$ read exactly one newspaper.
options.D: At least $37\frac12\%$ read exactly one newspaper.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
